payload.text: /plumb:plumb intent I want a very cheap way to stress test plumb. I want Haiku to use plumb and develop a simple playable game. Or feel free to find a relevant benchmark. Actually there could be a rather complex task and one quite simple game. The idea is to be able from one plumb dev command like plumb evaluate simple or plumb evaluate complex to be able to run this benchmark test and see how much haiku or Sonnet is able to implement autonomously using plumb tools. when ever Haiku finds issue, it writes into a file that we can later re-use to improve reliability of plumb
